title: Jonah and the Orbit
author: Odile Winterbourne
blurb: Hazel Halloran, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
